text: i need some plant shop ads
withheld: Three separate still ads: one square, one tall and one wide.
The ads should match each other.
Include exactly: Fern House; Weekend Plant Sale; 20% off all indoor plants; Saturday & Sunday; Visit 24 Willow Lane.
Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look.
Keep every line easy to read in all three ads, especially the address.
Rearrange the layout instead of shrinking the whole design.
The specific plants, fonts and layout are your call.
Use Saturday & Sunday as written; no calendar dates are needed.
